scope: Two C4 security records supplement, rather than enlarge, the seventeen performance-matrix records. Source and implementation inspection, not an independent experiment.

records.threat_boundary: Attacker-controlled tool content redirects a tool-integrated agent into harmful actions or data exfiltration.
records.observed_result: The primary study reports susceptibility under its model/prompt/attack settings. The released benchmark defines 1054 test cases, 17 user tools and 62 attacker tools; these are suite sizes, not a mobile risk rate.
records.replication_support: Task records, agent prompting, model adapters, parsing and evaluation scripts are visible.
records.missing_or_unverified: External model endpoints and exact paper-era responses/configurations were not rerun or established as invariant.
records.mobile_transfer_limit: No matched phone execution, local tool authorization, or complete-task energy measurement is established.

records.threat_boundary: Untrusted tool outputs attempt to redirect a multi-step agent; utility and adversarial success have separate task checks.
records.observed_result: The primary study reports benign-task failures and incomplete protection across tested attacks and defenses. Its published environment has 97 user tasks and 629 security test cases; counts are not a common denominator with InjecAgent.
records.replication_support: Suite/task definitions, attack/defense options and benchmark entry point are visible.
records.missing_or_unverified: Model/API drift and exact paper-era suite/environment behavior remain unverified; no independent rerun.
records.mobile_transfer_limit: API-backed tool environments do not establish permission-enforcement or energy guarantees on a client device.
